newsitem.title: USA: Positron gets $1.4 mln loan facility.
newsitem.headline: Positron gets $1.4 mln loan facility.

text.p: Positron Corp said on Friday it obtained a $1.4 million loan facility from ProFutures Bridge Capital Fund LP, with a 12 percent annual interest rate.

It said the loan helped complete its previously announced acquisition of General Electric Co's Positron emission tomography development and production operations. GE's GE Medical agreed to sell these operations to Positron in July for $25 million cash plus 10 percent of Positron's outstanding stock.
Positron said it was in the process of assembling financing facilities to complete that deal, which was expected to close in the near future.
The loan, secured by the company's assets, matures on June 301, 1997, Positron said.
